arxiv-1604-02167.title: Decidability of multiset, set and numerically decipherable directed figure codes
arxiv-1604-02167.creator: Włodzimierz Moczurad
arxiv-1604-02167.description: Abstract Codes with various kinds of decipherability, weaker than the usual unique decipherability, have been studied since multiset decipherability was introduced in mid-1980s. We consider decipherability of directed figure codes, where directed figures are defined as labelled polyominoes with designated start and end points, equipped with catenation operation that may use a merging function to resolve possible conflicts.

arxiv-2112-13661.title: Sound and light Doppler effects
arxiv-2112-13661.creator: Denis Michel
arxiv-2112-13661.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Denis Michel. Although electromagnetic and acoustic waves profoundly differ in their nature, comparing their Doppler effects is instructive and reveals persistent conceptual traps. The principle of the Doppler effect was presented by Christian Doppler in 1842 long before the advent of relativity theory, but while the relativistic Doppler effect is now well established, its non-relativistic version retrospectively called classical, suffers from misleading intuitions such as: (1) there is no transverse classical Doppler effect; (2) the Galilean Doppler effect corresponds to the relativistic one without

arxiv-2412-10856.title: RWKV-Lite: Deeply Compressed RWKV for Resource-Constrained Devices
arxiv-2412-10856.creator: Wonkyo Choe, Yangfeng Ji, Felix Xiaozhu Lin
arxiv-2412-10856.description: Abstract To deploy LLMs on resource-contained platforms such as mobile robots and smartphones, non-transformers LLMs have achieved major breakthroughs. Recently, a novel RNN-based LLM family, Repentance Weighted Key Value (RWKV) ( Peng et al., 2023 ; Peng et al., 2024 ) has shown strong computational efficiency; nevertheless, RWKV models still have high parameter counts which limited their deployment.

arxiv-2506-15710.title: RAST: R easoning A ctivation in LLMs via S mall-model T ransfer
arxiv-2506-15710.creator: Siru Ouyang, Xinyu Zhu, Zilin Xiao, Minhao Jiang, Yu Meng, Jiawei Han
arxiv-2506-15710.description: Abstract Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a powerful approach for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), as evidenced by recent successes such as OpenAI’s o1 and Deepseek-R1. However, applying RL at scale remains intimidatingly resource-intensive, requiring multiple model copies and extensive GPU workloads.

arxiv-2507-00793.title: Timing and spectral studies of SRGA J144459.2 − - 604207 with NICER, Einstein Probe, IXPE, NuSTAR, Insight -HXMT and INTEGRAL during its 2024 outburst
arxiv-2507-00793.creator: Zhaosheng Li, Lucien Kuiper, Yuanyue Pan, Renxin Xu, Yong Chen, Mingyu Ge, Yue Huang, Shumei Jia, Xiaobo Li, Liming Song, Jinlu Qu, Shu Zhang, Lian Tao, Hua Feng, Shuang-Nan Zhang, Maurizio Falanga
arxiv-2507-00793.description: Abstract SRGA J144459.2 − - 604207 is a newly confirmed accreting millisecond X-ray pulsar and type I X-ray burster. We present the broadband X-ray timing and spectral behaviors of SRGA J144459.2 − - 604207 during its 2024 outburst. The data were collected from NICER, Einstein Probe, IXPE, Insight -HXMT, NuSTAR and INTEGRAL observations.

arxiv-2509-00474.title: Energy non-equipartition in vibrofluidized particles
arxiv-2509-00474.creator: Alok Tiwari, Manaswita Bose, V. Kumaran
arxiv-2509-00474.description: Abstract The aim of the present work is to investigate the influence of the realistic model parameters on the equipartition of energy in a vibrofluidized system. To achieve this, a three-dimensional vertically vibrated granular system consisting of spherical particles is simulated using the discrete element method (DEM) using the open-source software LAMMPS.

arxiv-2601-02563.title: Compressed code: the hidden effects of quantization and distillation on programming tokens
arxiv-2601-02563.creator: Viacheslav Siniaev, Iaroslav Chelombitko, Aleksey Komissarov
arxiv-2601-02563.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated exceptional code generation capabilities, yet their token-level mechanisms remain underexplored, particularly in compressed models. Through systematic analysis of programming language token representations, we characterize how programming languages are encoded in LLM tokenizers by analyzing their vocabulary distribution and keyword coverage patterns.

pmc-10638174.title: Feasibility and Efficacy of Intensive Dialectical Behavior Therapy Skills Training in An Outpatient Setting for A Group of Patients with Extensive Care Needs - A Transdiagnostic Approach
pmc-10638174.creator: Christina Bertholds Felix, Peter Sand
pmc-10638174.description: PurposeDialectical behavior therapy (DBT) is a treatment originally developed för chronically suicidal adults. It is common to adapt it by using one specific component, the DBT skills training (DBT-ST) and apply it in a group therapy setting for a variety of mental disorders.

pmc-11427898.title: Data transformation and model selection in bivariate allometry
pmc-11427898.creator: Gary C Packard
pmc-11427898.description: Students of biological allometry have used the logarithmic transformation for over a century to linearize bivariate distributions that are curvilinear on the arithmetic scale. When the distribution is linear, the equation for a straight line fitted to the distribution can be back-transformed to form a two-parameter power function for describing the original observations.

pmc-11437558.title: Assessment of Voiding Dysfunction and Nocturnal Enuresis Rates in Primary School Children in Nablus, Palestine: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-11437558.creator: Suha Hamshari, Dima Salman, Dina Jaber, Raghad Dweik, Rola Abualwafa, Mahfouz Ktaifan, Sa’ed H. Zyoud, Maha Akkawi, Faris Abushamma
pmc-11437558.description: Background:Voiding dysfunction (VD) is a frequent reason for primary care referrals to urologists and pediatric urologists. VD symptoms include urine incontinence (UI), urinary tract infection (UTI), hyperactive bladder, and constipation. Early detection of Nocturnal enuresis is critical due to its high frequency and the consequences for families and children regarding psychological and behavioral aspects.

pmc-11647362.title: Sociodemographic and clinical predictors of quality-of-life outcome in children and young people with primary brain tumour in Karachi, Pakistan: a prospective cohort study
pmc-11647362.creator: Nida Zahid, Syed Ather Enam, Thomas Mårtensson, Iqbal Azam, Naureen Mushtaq, Mariya Moochhala, Aneesa Hassan, Faiza Kausar, Saqib Bakhshi, Lal Rehman, Farrukh Javeed, Muhammad Nouman Mughal, Sadaf Altaf, Salman Kirmani, Nick Brown
pmc-11647362.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundChildren and young people (CYP) with primary brain tumour (PBT) are at high risk for developing late effects, potentially affecting long-term quality of life (QoL). In low-income and middle-income countries, QoL has not been studied in depth in CYP.

pmc-12397411.title: Prevalence of physical activity among pregnant women attending antenatal care services in public facilities Harari region Eastern Ethiopia
pmc-12397411.creator: Reyad Shek Adem, Aboma Motuma, Behailu Hawulte Ayele
pmc-12397411.description: Background Regular physical activity during pregnancy is crucial in promoting fetal growth, reducing the risk of pregnancy complications, enhancing labor and postpartum experiences, supporting mental and emotional well-being, and improving overall health. However, there is a dearth of evidence on the practice of physical activity among pregnant women in Ethiopia.

pmc-12603145.title: A convolutional neural network-based framework for quality control through speckle displacement analysis
pmc-12603145.creator: Hamed Sabahno, Davood Khodadad
pmc-12603145.description: Among the most advanced techniques for quality control, image processing and optical methods are prominent because of their precision and versatility. These methods often involve analyzing speckles generated by coherent laser illumination because coherent light provides detailed and accurate measurement capabilities. In speckle metrology-based techniques, the accurate measurement of speckle displacements is crucial for detecting faults or deformations in objects.

pmc-12765700.title: Mapping Menstrual Health Research in France: A Scoping Review of Peer-Reviewed Literature Up to 2024
pmc-12765700.creator: Violeta Alarcão, Elise de La Rochebrochard
pmc-12765700.description: Menstrual health is increasingly framed as a multidimensional public issue intersecting with health, education, and gender equality. Yet, national research landscapes remain uneven, shaped by structural neglect, epistemic silences, and sociocultural stigma. France offers a compelling case of such disparities, where academic engagement with menstrual health has only recently gained visibility.

pmc-12982293.title: Climatic, environmental factors and agricultural practices favoring dynamics of the spread of African cassava mosaic disease in Côte d’Ivoire
pmc-12982293.creator: Bekanvié S M Kouakou, John Steven S Seka, Justin S Pita, Aya Ange Naté Yoboué, Israël Tankam Chedjou, Guy Roland Eboulem, Nazaire K Kouassi, Fidèle Tiendrébéogo, Fatogoma Sorho
pmc-12982293.description: Cassava mosaic disease (CMD), caused by begomoviruses, poses a major threat to cassava leading to huge yield losses. We analyzed climatic (temperature, humidity, rainfall), non-climatic (altitude, field density, cropping system) variables and also the susceptibility of cassava varieties grown in each agroecological zone, to understand their joint influence on CMD’s spatiotemporal spread in Côte d’Ivoire.

pmc-13022015.title: Increased vulnerability to low-density lipoprotein cholesterol in apolipoprotein E4-positive females: Longitudinal effects on neurodegeneration and cognition
pmc-13022015.creator: Abdul Jaber Tayem, Ahmad Bani Jaber, Ahmad M Altantawi, Noor M Masadeh, Laith Al Quran, Omar Al-Jammal, for the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative
pmc-13022015.description: BackgroundAlzheimer's disease (AD) is the most common form of dementia, marked by progressive cognitive decline. Low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C) has been implicated in AD pathology, but findings remain inconsistent. Apolipoprotein E4 (APOE4) status and sex may contribute to this variability.ObjectiveTo examine how LDL-C association with neurodegeneration in AD patients, differ according to APOE4 status and gender.

pmc-13211943.title: Differences in Safety Risks Across Languages in Health-Relevant Queries: Vulnerability Analysis of Large Language Model Responses
pmc-13211943.creator: Saubhagya Joshi, Monjil A Mehta, Melissa Mendoza, Yonaira M Rivera, Vivek K Singh
pmc-13211943.description: BackgroundLarge language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT are increasingly used to support health-related queries and decision-making. However, these models can be “jailbroken” through adversarial prompts that bypass safety filters and elicit harmful or medically inappropriate responses. In health care contexts, such vulnerabilities pose serious risks.

pmc-13278843.title: The grapevine LysM receptor kinase VvLYK4-2 is a key player in chitosan-triggered immune responses
pmc-13278843.creator: Thibault Roudaire, Jérémy Villette, Tania Marzari, Daphnée Brulé, Stéphanie Pradeau, Sébastien Fort, David Landry, Benoit Lefebvre, Marie-Claire Héloir, Benoit Poinssot
pmc-13278843.description: Chitooligosaccharides, such as chitin, are essential components of fungal cell walls and have thus naturally been selected as microbe-associated molecular patterns detected by plants to initiate defense mechanisms. These molecules are typically recognized by the lysin motif receptor-like kinases (LysM RLKs) at the plasma membrane.

pmc-13384964.title: Empowering prevention: uterine cancer awareness and advocacy in the digital age and world of social media
pmc-13384964.creator: Esra Bilir, Wasim Ahmed, Xezal Derin, Joanna Kacperczyk-Bartnik, Christina Fotopoulou, Sara Nasser
pmc-13384964.description: PurposeWe aim to evaluate the reach, engagement, and evolution of the inaugural Uterine Cancer Awareness Month (UCAM) social media campaign (2023–2024) on Twitter/X, focusing on user participation, content trends, and key influencers.MethodsWe conducted a social network analysis of Twitter/X posts using the hashtags #endometrialcancer, #uterinecancer, and #wombcancer over three years (2022–2024).

pmc-13415493.title: Mathematical Modeling of Systemic Sclerosis and Its Treatment
pmc-13415493.creator: Teddy Lazebnik, Avner Friedman
pmc-13415493.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Systemic sclerosis (SSc) is an autoimmune disease marked by excessive extracellular matrix (ECM) deposited by myofibroblasts. The disease carries the risk of pathologically progressing to internal organs, particularly the lung. Since abnormally large densities of myofibroblasts are associated with SSc, clinical studies consider trials that reduce the density of myofibroblasts: imatinib treatment (N), which promotes apoptosis in myofibroblasts, and SSc by fresolimumab (S), which inhibits TGF-β, a key growth factor of myofibroblasts.
